parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the microwave is made of stainless steel, forming the structural boundary that supports the door and control panel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity and protection for internal components, ensuring the microwave maintains its shape and safety during operation.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door is made of tempered glass with a metal or plastic border, allowing users to view the food while it cooks.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as a shield to contain microwaves and provides access to the cooking chamber when opened.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates on hinges to open and close, allowing access to the interior.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side control panel is made of durable plastic and includes buttons, knobs, and a display for user input.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to set cooking time, power level, and other functions.
parts.Movement_description: The knobs rotate and buttons depress to register user input.

parts.name: Body Interior
parts.Basic_description: The body interior is made of enameled steel, forming the cooking chamber of the microwave.
parts.Functional_description: It reflects microwaves evenly to heat food and is easy to clean due to its smooth enamel coating.
parts.Movement_description: The interior is fixed, but it may contain a rotating glass plate that moves during operation.
